1803: Britain retakes Tobago.

wars.name: War of the Spanish Succession
wars.outcome: The Treaty of Utrecht (11 April 1713 with France; the Spanish treaties later in 1713) gave Britain Gibraltar and Menorca from Spain and Nova Scotia, Newfoundland claims, Rupert's Land claims and the French part of Saint Kitts from France.

wars.name: Seven Years' War
wars.outcome: Treaty of Paris, signed 10 February 1763: France ceded Canada, Cape Breton, eastern Louisiana and several Windward islands; Spain ceded Florida; Britain restored Havana, Manila, Guadeloupe, Martinique and Saint Lucia.

wars.name: American Revolutionary War
wars.outcome: Treaty of Paris, signed 3 September 1783: Britain recognised the United States ('free, sovereign, and independent states') with the Great Lakes and Mississippi line; East and West Florida and Menorca went to Spain; Tobago and Senegal to France; Bahamas…

wars.name: French Revolutionary Wars
wars.outcome: Treaty of Amiens, signed 25 March 1802: Britain returned the Cape Colony and most of Dutch Guiana and Menorca but kept Ceylon and Trinidad.

wars.name: Napoleonic Wars
wars.outcome: Britain took Mauritius (1810) and Java (1811); the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 13 August 1814 returned the Dutch colonies except the Cape Colony, which was ceded, with trading rights in Demerara, Essequibo and Berbice; Java went back in 1816 (TE).

wars.name: First Opium War
wars.outcome: Britain seized Hong Kong Island (BE: 'the seizure by Britain of Hong Kong Island'); TE: occupied 1841, Crown colony 1843-1982.

wars.name: Mesopotamian campaign
wars.outcome: British landings at Fao (6 November 1914) and Basra (22 November 1914), Kut lost 29 April 1916, Baghdad taken 11 March 1917, Mudros 30 October 1918, Mosul 14 November 1918; the campaign ended with a British mandate over Mesopotamia.

wars.name: Anglo-Soviet invasion of Iran
wars.outcome: Invasion 25 August 1941, ceasefire 29-30 August, Reza Shah's abdication 16 September, tripartite treaty 29 January 1942; the British held southern Iran (south of Hamadan and Qazvin) until the Allied withdrawal of March 1946.

wars.name: Pacific War
wars.outcome: Hong Kong, Malaya and the Straits Settlements were under Japanese occupation 1942-1945 and under British military administration 1945-1946 (TE).

certainty.note: Colonial frontiers are approximate: a scatter of coastal settlements, plantation districts and trading posts, with the interior lines of North America, the Hudson Bay shore, Australia's interior and the Canadian north undrawn by treaty.
Dominion, colony and treaty-port borders are fixed by statute or treaty (Labrador by the 11 March 1927 decision, CAN).
